services.name: Guided Trail Rides
services.desc: Come saddle up and join us in the great outdoors for a scenic horseback trail ride! You will be guided by our friendly and knowledgeable wrangler staff through the timber of Jester Park and take in the picturesque view of Saylorville Lake. Need to Know Guided Trail Rides are $80 per person. Your reservation will include all check-in procedures, riding instructions, and saddle time on the trails. Rides depart at 9:30 am, 11:00 am, and 2:00 pm and are regularly scheduled on Fridays and Saturdays. Please arrive 10-15 minutes early. services.name: Wagon Rides
services.desc: Come out to Jester Park Equestrian Center and enjoy a fun group or family outing as a team of draft horses pull your open wagon down the beautiful timber trails of Jester Park. Horse Drawn Wagon Rides are group rides, taking out up to 12 people on the wagon at a time. Wagon Rides are great for family outings, groups of friends, and club and organization outings. Horse Drawn Wagon Rides are great for all ages. For riders who may require additional support getting into the wagon (ie: wheel chairs) a ramp is available upon request. services.name: Carriage Trail Ride
services.desc: Not sure you're ready to ride a horse on the trail? Sit back, relax, and enjoy a scenic ride in our horse-drawn carriage instead!

services.name: Holiday Horse-Drawn Rides
services.desc: We’ll hitch up our draft horse team to either a wagon or a sleigh, depending on the snow conditions, and take you out for a 30-minute ride through Jester Park. Horse-Drawn Rides are great for all ages. Need to Know Sleigh Rides require a minimum of 6 inches of packed snow as a proper base for the sleigh. A wagon will be used when there is no snow or not enough snow to pull a sleigh. Holiday Horse-Drawn Rides are 30 minutes in length through the trails of Jester Park and are weather dependent. Please arrive 15 minutes early for your ride. All rides require a reservation. All rides can hold twelve guests. Hand-held snacks and non-alcoholic drinks are welcome on the ride. services.name: Horses Helping Heroes
services.desc: Established in September 2016, Horses Helping Heroes (H3) is an on-the-ground Equine-Assisted Activity Learning and Therapy (EAAL/T) program for military Veterans and Service Members at no charge. Skills you may learn from equine-assisted therapy include emotional regulation, self-confidence, improved communication and relationship skills, mindfulness, and many others. This is not a riding program; we use ground-based horsemanship activities. Group sessions are led by an EAGALA-credentialed equine Specialist with VACIHCS support to ensure each participant receives the guidance to explore, process, and solve their specific challenges in a safe and supportive environment.
